newsitem.title: SWEDEN: IBS says seeks Nasdaq listing, new issue.
newsitem.headline: IBS says seeks Nasdaq listing, new issue.

text.p: Swedish software company IBS said on Tuesday it registered its prospectus for a new share issue and a listing of depositary receipts on the Nasdaq bourse in the U.S.
IBS plans to issue four million series B shares with an option of an additional 900,000 shares to international investors, the company said in a statement.
In addition, Munkenes AS, Procedo Capital Corp and IBM Svenska AB intend to sell a total of 2.6 million shares in the transaction.
On condition that the sale to international investors is successful, the Nasdaq listing will take place at the end of March, the company said.
Credit Suisse First Boston will be lead manager in the share issue with Robertson Stephens & Company and Enskilda Securities as co-managers.
IBS has 1,225 employees and its 1996 turnover amounted to 997 million crowns.
